explanation: Australia's strict quarantine rules for imported horses forced the move, so riders competed in Sweden in June, five months before the rest of the Games opened in Melbourne.

claims.text: The equestrian events of the 1956 Olympics were held in Stockholm, Sweden, rather than in Melbourne.
The 1956 equestrian events were not held in Sydney, Auckland or Helsinki.
Australian quarantine rules for imported horses were the reason the equestrian events were moved.
The Stockholm equestrian events ran from 10 to 17 June 1956, and the Melbourne Games opened on 22 November 1956, about five months later.
